stackDivergence.rationale: Task65 connects actual initialized object ValueT ownership to the existing delayed_delete_vector/default_element_block operation family, reusing shared vector special-member helpers. Count/default constructs independent values; count/fill and range/copy perform actual value copies including hidden constructed prefixes. Reference assignment, append/lvalue emplace, range insertion, resize/default construction, erase, reserve/shrink, equality and destructor preserve original native operators. Original mdds block swap performs two copies and copy assignments; actual std::iter_swap remains a distinct move-temporary operation. Scalar and borrowed-pointer paths remain shared. Pure callers over unchanged mdds3.2.1 headers and full actual SharedString/CellTextAttr sources use verified existing complete native dependency objects and normal-only witness execution, comparing whole owned and Calc streams. Existing SharedString and CellTextAttr owners are reused; external mdds imports no Calc/SVL. Custom allocators/StoreT, throwing cleanup, undefined ranges/lifetimes, complete perfect-forwarding/rvalue overload families, physical ABI, pointee/callback/container/document/UI owners remain unverified.
